title: Blind retries work only when correct products are self-inactivating and misses remain competent
statement: For constant per-opportunity correct p>0, permanent wrong w>=0,p+w<=1 and otherwise identical competent miss, correct and wrong products absorbing, m integer feeds give Y_m=sum_(k=0)^(m-1) p*(1-p-w)^k. Thus Y_m=p/(p+w)*[1-(1-p-w)^m] for m>=1 and Y_0=0. L independent sites have full-correct yield Y_m^L, bounded by[p/(p+w)]^L even with unlimited retries.

requires: One uniquely addressed reactive amine; correct product stable and self-inactivating with no new reactive payload site.
Identical independent feed opportunities with constant p,w and chemically competent misses; L-site product only for independent sites.
provides: For constant per-opportunity correct p>0, permanent wrong w>=0,p+w<=1 and otherwise identical competent miss, correct and wrong products absorbing, m integer feeds give Y_m=sum_(k=0)^(m-1) p*(1-p-w)^k. Thus Y_m=p/(p+w)*[1-(1-p-w)^m] for m>=1 and Y_0=0. L independent sites have full-correct yield Y_m^L, bounded by[p/(p+w)]^L even with unlimited retries.
assumptions: m is a nonnegative integer and L a positive integer; m=0 has zero success.
Persistent death, wrong-site chemistry, shared depletion and obstructing retained guides cannot be silently classified as harmless misses.
costs: Pay every feed/clearance, wrong-product loss, finite retry residual, root preservation and real acquisition of p,w.
contract.units: p,w,Y and alpha are dimensionless; feeds/sites are counts, not measured rate or total-cost advantage.
contract.obstruction: Acquire actual stable idempotent chemistry and competent-parent recovery before claiming sensorless repair.

body: Correct transfer must consume the sole target amine without exposing a new nucleophile and preserve the rooted amide through all later feeds; a competent miss restores the same parent. First correct success at feed k+1 requires k misses, yielding the geometric sum. Permanent wrong acylation absorbs the site and cannot be washed into a harmless miss. For target alpha in(0,1), even the limiting L-site ceiling is below alpha when w>p*(alpha^(-1/L)-1); finite feeds need a separate residual-miss allowance. The source m14/p=.6/w=1e-6/L1000 value is an illustrative report, not measured kinetics. At m=0 the empty sum is zero even when p+w=1; for m>=1 and p+w=1 it is p. Source protected_transfer_yield instead returns p^L at p+w=1 for every permitted m>=0, so its zero-feed boundary is erroneous. Preserve the original code, use the analytic law and do not extend acceptance to that branch. No current result JSON/log is supplied. Persistent dead sites, reactivity after correct transfer, cross-acylation, depletion and guide occlusion violate this simple retry interface. Donor self-cleavage alone supplies neither product-qualified progress nor noncovalent guide removal.

evidence.range_scope: Self-inactivating correct products, identical competent misses, finite retry sum and permanent wrong-product ceiling.
evidence.quote: ## Finding E: sensorless retries are mathematically robust only when the covalent product is self-inactivating
